en.applyCustom: Apply (replaces the current llm-pi-ai user section)
en.applyToAllModels: Apply this model's settings to all models in this route
en.builtinMaxThinkingDesc: Declare all seven thinking levels (offu2192max) on every model and set high default thinking.
en.builtinOpenaiNativeDesc: compat: developer role on, thinkingFormat=openai, maxTokensField=max_completion_tokens.
en.builtinSafeGatewayDesc: compat: supportsDeveloperRole=false u2014 for gateways that reject the 'developer' role (DashScope, Kimi, Zhipu, MiniMax u2026).
en.compatIntro: compat fields describe what the gateway understands. Mismatches are the most common cause of 400 errors (e.g. the message role 'developer').
en.confirmApplyCustom: Apply this preset? It replaces the current user section of the llm-pi-ai settings.
en.defaultsIntro: Fallbacks used for models/turns that do not declare a value.
en.diagDeveloperRole: {route}: baseURL looks like a legacy gateway but compat.supportsDeveloperRole is on u2014 safe-gateway preset or manual off avoids 400 errors.
en.diagEmptyEffort: {route} / {model}: reasoningEfforts.{level} is empty (only 'off' may send nothing) u2014 the Host will reject the write.
en.diagLooseEfforts: {route} / {model}: declares reasoningEfforts but thinking is disabled for the model entry (reasoningEfforts: false keeps it disabled).
en.diagNoContext: {route} / {model}: no contextWindow u2014 DSH falls back to the route default.
en.diagNoModels: {route}: declares no models u2014 the route serves its built-in catalog.
en.diagNone: No advisories for the current configuration.
en.diagPresetCreds: Preset "{preset}": route "{route}" contains credential headers ({names}) in its payload. The preset was saved before the strip-headers safeguard. Delete and re-save the preset, then rotate any exposed keys.
en.fillLevels: Fill all levels with their own name
en.memoryMode: This browser cannot persist settings (loopback required).
en.modelNotFound: Model not found in this route.
en.notWritable: Settings are read-only in this browser (remote access).
en.noUserRoutesHint: Nothing to save u2014 no routes have been edited yet.
en.pageIntro: Manage the llm-pi-ai provider routes: per-model thinking levels, context / output capacity, input modalities, gateway compatibility, and route defaults. Edits are written to the active DSH profile and validated by the Host.
en.presetCorrupt: This preset contains invalid data and could not be applied.
en.presetFailed: Preset was rejected by the settings service:
en.presetIntro: Apply a curated configuration to selected routes in one click (writes are validated by the Host).
en.reasoningFalseHint: Setting thinking off stores reasoningEfforts: false u2014 DSH will not offer thinking levels for this model.
en.reasoningNeedsOneLevel: At least one thinking level besides 'off' needs a wire value.
en.requiresAssistantAfterToolResult: Requires assistant msgs after tool results
en.requiresToolResultName: Requires a name on tool results
en.routeNotFound: Route not found in the resolved settings.
en.savePreset: Save current settings as a preset
en.savePresetBlurb: Stores a snapshot of the current llm-pi-ai user section into the model-capability settings namespace.
en.supportsDeveloperRoleHint: Off for older gateways (DashScope / Kimi / Zhipu / MiniMax / SiliconFlow u2026) that only understand 'system'.
en.syncIntro: Fetch capabilities on demand, map each local route to a models.dev provider, preview the match, then apply. Only existing models with matching IDs are updated; routes and models are never added or removed.
en.syncPreview: Preview: {matchedModels} matched, {changedModels} would change, {unmatchedModels} unmatched across {selectedRoutes} selected routes.
en.syncReasoningHint: Reasoning sync is conservative and opt-in: false disables it; explicit effort values are mapped; toggle-only/unknown formats keep the current manual value.
en.syncSkippedReasoning: {count} reasoning entries have no safe effort mapping and will remain unchanged.
en.syncStaleFallback: models.dev was unavailable, so the last successful local cache is shown.
en.syncUnavailable: The catalog could not be loaded; settings were not changed.
en.thinkingBudgetsHint: DSH defines budgets for minimal/low/medium/high; the xhigh and max levels are folded into high by the host.
en.thinkingHint: Key = selectable level, value = the wire spelling sent for that level. Only 'off' may stay empty (send nothing).
en.writableHost: Edits are persisted to the active DSH profile.
